title: How much can you hold in mind?

probes.question: About how many chunks can young adults hold in working memory at once?

sources.title: The Magical Number Seven, Plus or Minus Two (Wikipedia)

image.alt: Four small rounded tiles, each holding four coloured dots, arranged in a two-by-two grid inside a large pale circle.

body.question: About how many separate chunks of information can young adults hold in working memory at once?
body.reveal: Research since 2001 suggests about four chunks, not the 'seven plus or minus two' from the famous 1956 paper.
